description: Japanese ad-claim compliance screening: flags risky wording in Japanese ads, product pages and SNS posts under 薬機法 (cure/disease claims, rejuvenation, body-function, safety guarantees, doctor endorsements), 景品表示法 (No.1/superlatives without basis, double pricing, fake urgency, subscription traps) and ステマ規制 (missing #PR disclosure), with English explanations and safer alternatives. Cautionary screening against public guidelines, not legal advice. Costs 0.05 USDC via x402.

category.description: Product category (default general); stricter rules for cosmetics/foods

sponsored.description: true if paid/gifted/commissioned content (checks ad disclosure strictly)

text.description: Japanese ad / product copy / SNS post, up to 4000 characters

name: check_japanese_ad_claims
